name: Dinesh Chandra Sen
contribution: Dinesh Chandra Sen collected, edited, and interpreted Bengali folklore and literature, bringing the Mymensingh ballads to wider scholarly attention.
context: Late-colonial Bengali literary scholarship and the study of vernacular oral traditions.
impact: His work helped establish folklore and regional literary traditions as important subjects in the study of Bengali culture.
highlight: Dinesh Chandra Sen was a pioneering scholar of Bengali folklore and literary history.
seoTitle: Dinesh Chandra Sen: Scholar of Bengali Folklore
seoDescription: Learn about Dinesh Chandra Sen's scholarship on Bengali folklore, literature, and the Mymensingh ballads.
shortAnswer: Dinesh Chandra Sen was a Bengali scholar who documented folklore and regional literary traditions, including the Mymensingh ballads.
